result:
I wrote round 256: **SABA-B-9 stage 1**, which puts the transport in the centre and adds a Stop button. The decision is **CONTINUE**.

**Round 255 result:** C passed it in the browser with 0 bugs, and the gate published `a061d52`. So SABA-B-10b is done, and C-R254-01, GATE249-S4/S5/S7, A-R250-REVIEW-SHEET-MARKER-COPY and INFO-B249-STALE-MARKER-STATUS are closed in `backlog.json`. The regression round isn't due yet: the last one was 2026-10-27, and today is 10-29. It will be due at the next planning, which will almost certainly fall on or after 10-30.

**What round 256 asks A to build:**
- **Toolbar in three groups:** edit tools on the left; Follow · clock · Play · **Stop** · back to start · Loop in the centre; Zoom, Fit and Export on the right. The order follows the Live 12 Control Bar.
- **Stop button:** one click stops playback; one click while already stopped does nothing; a double-click sends the playhead and insert marker back to the start (manual 6.3).
- **Play button:** it no longer turns into "Pause" (this closes B-R249-PAUSE-LABEL). Clicking it while playing does nothing, and it shows a visible "playing" look.
- **`?` sheet:** the back-to-start row also lists "Double-click Stop".
- **Moving master volume to the bottom-right** is stage 2, after the regression round. That move changes the header and everything below it, so it gets its own round.

**What I checked before writing it:**
- **Toolbar heights at HEAD:** 49 px at 1440 and 87 px (already two rows) at 1280.
- **One row at 1280 is not possible.** The three groups need about 1,399 px for one centred row. Fitting 1280 would mean removing about 96 px of button text, which conflicts with Saba's earlier rule that the transport text buttons stay.
- **What A builds instead:** two rows at 1280, with the transport alone and centred in the first row, at the same 87 px height as today.
- **One side effect:** between about 1,351 and 1,398 px wide (for example 1366×768), the toolbar becomes two rows where it used to be one.
- **Test collisions:** I applied a sketch of the change to a scratch copy and ran typecheck plus the arrangement tests. Nine test files collide, and all nine are granted to A with rules that no assertion may be dropped.
- **Sketch in a real browser:**
  - the centre group sits 1 px off centre;
  - Play while playing does nothing;
  - Stop, a second Stop, and a double-click (stopped or playing) all behave as specified;
  - the `?` sheet grows from 1,260 to 1,280 px.

**New Saba question SABA-Q-9-TRANSPORT.** The manual says nothing about three of these behaviours, so they are open questions. I implemented a default for each, and the loop doesn't wait for his answers:
- (a) what Play does while playing;
- (b) what one click on Stop does while stopped;
- (c) the 1280 two-row layout and the 1351–1398 px change;
- (d) how Play looks while playing.

**Other updates:** `feature-status.md` and the lesson L43 note (still 58 lines). The round-255 task is archived as `tasks/round-255.md`, and the files I edited are snapshotted in `b-round-255/`. The store repository was not touched. The advisor was used twice. Its second check found that my first bound ("never taller than HEAD at any width") would have failed at 1366; I measured the in-between widths and rewrote the bound.

**Next:** the regression round at the next planning, then SABA-B-9 stage 2 (master volume), then SABA-B-11c, then SABA-B-7 once Saba answers.

Sources:
- [Ableton Live 12 manual, Live Concepts (Control Bar)](https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/live-concepts/)
